proof_scope: Proof identity correlation (#1436 hardening): the validator independently rejects a proof whose supplied identity fields do not belong together -- a stopped frame from a different session/run than the request, or a stop over source that drifted after the breakpoint request (unless the frame was explicitly re-established). Fields are checked only when the producer supplies them, so an un-instrumented proof is neither hardened nor broken by this layer.

claims.proves: validate_debugger_proof.py rejects (exit 1) a proofValid=true proof whose stopped session/run differs from the requested session/run, and one whose hit-breakpoint sourceHash (at request) differs from the stopped frame sourceHash (at stop) without re-establishment; and accepts (exit 0) a proof where source drift was explicitly re-established, and one whose session and source hash correlate
claims.does_not_prove: event-history hash-chain integrity, repo SHA/dirty-state binding, or that any specific producer actually emits these identity fields

cases.name: reject-cross-session-frame
cases.description: A proof whose stopped session differs from the requested session is rejected, even though the frame file matches a hit breakpoint.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-cross-session.json

cases.name: reject-source-drift-after-request
cases.description: A proof whose hit-breakpoint sourceHash (at request) differs from the stopped frame sourceHash (at stop), with no re-establishment, is rejected.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-source-drift.json

cases.name: accept-drift-explicitly-reestablished
cases.description: Source drift that was explicitly re-established before the stop is accepted.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-source-drift-reestablished.json --expect-valid

cases.name: accept-correlated-session-and-source
cases.description: A proof whose session and source hash correlate between request and stop is accepted.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-correlated-valid.json --expect-valid
